evidence.evidence_note: First Spin verdict = the standardized paid-run verdict receipt (real 402 + real paid-protocol run, 2026-09-15). Needle Drop ref = the hash-chained attestation receipt sealing that verdict (authorship evidence, resolvable without trusting this directory).

notes: Private pilot: no public base URL yet — endpoint runs on the owner's VM; public reach via owner tunnel or hosted deploy is pending owner approval. Listed with reachability=private per the listing policy.
payTo in the 402 challenge is a locally generated test-only address (Sepolia funds are play money). The owner must replace it with their own address before any real use.

On-chain settlement NOT yet proven: the paid-protocol run reached real facilitator verdicts (insufficient_balance on a valid signature; verify timeouts facilitator-side) but no settled tx hash exists. settlement_proven=false until the funded-buyer test completes.

Base mainnet (eip155:8453) is NOT live: the public x402.org facilitator is testnet-only; mainnet requires the owner's CDP facilitator key plus explicit approval. Never describe this listing as mainnet.

status_definitions.delisted: Removed from active results. The entry is kept as a tombstone (with reason and date) for audit, never silently deleted.
status_definitions.live_mainnet: Earning on a production network. Requires: settled tx hash on record, mainnet facilitator, public endpoint.
status_definitions.stale: last_reverified is older than 7 days. Flagged in place; re-verify or delist within 7 more days.
status_definitions.testnet_pilot: Earning on a test network, or reachable only privately. Priced in real protocol terms but not production money.
